templates.open_readonly_windows_observer_assistant:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if($taskSize-cnotin@('80x24','120x36','180x55')){throw 'Unknown capture size'}
$c=Get-Content -Raw evidence/080-interactive-assistantpref-agent-active-context-20261108.json|ConvertFrom-Json
$r=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $c.ready_file|ConvertFrom-Json
$code=@'
import json,sys,time,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
s=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
assert s['status']=='running' and time.time()<s['expires_unix_time']
binary=s['runtime']['tmux_executable']
p=subprocess.run([binary,'-u','-S',s['socket'],'list-clients','-F','#{client_pid}|#{client_tty}|#{client_flags}|#{client_width}x#{client_height}'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=3)
print(json.dumps({'socket':s['socket'],'binary':binary,'clients_before':p.stdout.splitlines()}))
'@
$raw=& wsl -d Ubuntu -u piotr --exec $r.python_launcher -I -B -c $code $r.manifest
if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'Live observer metadata failed'}
$meta=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$pkg=Get-AppxPackage -Name Microsoft.WindowsTerminal
$wt=Join-Path $pkg.InstallLocation 'wt.exe'
$title='DevBrain Capture '+$taskSize
$path=Join-Path $c.artifact_root ('windows-observer-'+$taskSize+'.json')
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $path){throw 'Fresh observer record required'}
$psi=[Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
$psi.FileName=$wt;$psi.UseShellExecute=$false;$psi.WindowStyle=[Diagnostics.ProcessWindowStyle]::Normal
foreach($v in @('-w','new','--size',$taskSize.Replace('x',','),'new-tab','--title',$title,
 (Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'System32/wsl.exe'),'--distribution','Ubuntu','--user','piotr','--exec',
 $meta.binary,'-u','-S',$meta.socket,'attach-session','-r','-f','ignore-size','-t','devbrain-ui')){$psi.ArgumentList.Add($v)}
$proc=[Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
try{$pidLaunched=$proc.Id}finally{$proc.Dispose()}
$record=[ordered]@{schema_version=1;run_id=$c.run_id;title=$title;size_requested=$taskSize;readonly=$true;ignore_size=$true;launcher_pid=$pidLaunched;socket=$meta.socket;binary=$meta.binary;clients_before=$meta.clients_before;launched_utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');os_screenshot_captured=$false}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($path,($record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
templates.capture_live_windows_observer_assistantp:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$c=Get-Content -Raw evidence/080-interactive-assistantpref-agent-active-context-20261108.json|ConvertFrom-Json
$r=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $c.ready_file|ConvertFrom-Json
$recordPath=Join-Path $c.artifact_root ('windows-observer-'+$taskSize+'.json')
$record=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $recordPath|ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
$code=@'
import json,sys,time,subprocess,os,termios
from pathlib import Path
s=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); old=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())
assert s['status']=='running' and time.time()<s['expires_unix_time']
binary=s['runtime']['tmux_executable']; base=[binary,'-u','-S',s['socket']]
p=subprocess.run(base+['list-clients','-F','#{client_pid}|#{client_tty}|#{client_flags}|#{client_width}x#{client_height}'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=3)
status_raw=subprocess.run(base+['show-options','-A','-v','-t','devbrain-ui','status'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=3).stdout.strip()
status_rows={'on':1,'off':0}.get(status_raw)
if status_rows is None: status_rows=int(status_raw)
assert 0<=status_rows<=5
before={int(row.split('|')[0]) for row in old['clients_before']}
candidates=[]
for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
 fields=line.split('|'); pid=int(fields[0]); flags=fields[2].split(',')
 if pid in before: continue
 assert 'read-only' in flags and 'ignore-size' in flags
 assert fields[3]==old['size_requested']
 raw=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text().rpartition(')')[2].split()
 assert Path(f'/proc/{pid}').stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
 assert os.readlink(f'/proc/{pid}/exe')==binary
 fd=os.open(fields[1],os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOCTTY|os.O_NONBLOCK)
 try: rows,cols=termios.tcgetwinsize(fd)
 finally:os.close(fd)
 assert f'{cols}x{rows}'==old['size_requested']
 pane=subprocess.run(base+['display-message','-p','-t','devbrain-ui:workspace','#{window_width}x#{window_height}|#{pane_width}x#{pane_height}'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=3).stdout.strip()
 assert pane.split('|')[0]==f'{cols}x{rows-status_rows}', 'active app window differs from client minus status rows'
 candidates.append({'pid':pid,'birth':raw[19],'tty':fields[1],'flags':flags,'tty_size':[cols,rows],'client_size':fields[3],'window_and_active_pane':pane,'status_rows':status_rows})
assert len(candidates)==1, 'observer is not unique'
print(json.dumps(candidates[0]))
'@
$linuxRecord='/mnt/c/'+$recordPath.Substring(3).Replace('\','/')
$raw=& wsl -d Ubuntu -u piotr --exec $r.python_launcher -I -B -c $code $r.manifest $linuxRecord
if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'Observer geometry/identity not verified'}
$live=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
$owners=@(Get-Process -Name WindowsTerminal -ErrorAction Stop|Where-Object{$_.MainWindowTitle-ceq$record.title-and$_.MainWindowHandle-ne0})
if($owners.Count-ne1){throw 'Exact named Windows Terminal window not uniquely available'}
$owner=$owners[0]
$record.actual_observer=$live
$record.windows_owner=@{pid=$owner.Id;start_filetime=$owner.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToFileTimeUtc();hwnd=$owner.MainWindowHandle.ToInt64();title=$owner.MainWindowTitle;executable=$owner.Path}
$record.os_geometry_verified=$true
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($recordPath,($record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$script=Join-Path (Get-Location) 'release-tools/capture-devbrain-window080.ps1'
if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $script).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()-cne'71afe70ebe3bcfc137417f8a6c5a46c5ed1b2e3421654b7ce754b9ddf67fbbf4'){throw 'Capture source changed'}
$png=Join-Path $c.artifact_root ('windows-terminal-080-'+$taskSize+'.png')
& $script -WindowHandle $record.windows_owner.hwnd -Title $record.title -ExpectedProcessId $record.windows_owner.pid -ExpectedProcessStartFileTime $record.windows_owner.start_filetime -OutputPath $png -Execute
if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
templates.detach_readonly_windows_observer_assista:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$c=Get-Content -Raw evidence/080-interactive-assistantpref-agent-active-context-20261108.json|ConvertFrom-Json
$r=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $c.ready_file|ConvertFrom-Json
$p=Join-Path $c.artifact_root ('windows-observer-'+$taskSize+'.json')
$lp='/mnt/c/'+$p.Substring(3).Replace('\','/')
$code=@'
import json,sys,os,select,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
s=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); old=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()); row=old['actual_observer']
assert old['run_id']==s['run_id']
pid=row['pid']; fd=os.pidfd_open(pid)
try:
 raw=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text().rpartition(')')[2].split()
 assert raw[19]==row['birth'] and os.readlink(f'/proc/{pid}/exe')==s['runtime']['tmux_executable']
 assert not select.select([fd],[],[],0)[0]
 base=[s['runtime']['tmux_executable'],'-u','-S',s['socket']]
 text=subprocess.run(base+['list-clients','-F','#{client_pid}|#{client_tty}|#{client_flags}'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=3).stdout
 lines=[line.split('|') for line in text.splitlines()]
 exact=[line for line in lines if line[0]==str(pid) and line[1]==row['tty']]
 assert len(exact)==1 and 'read-only' in exact[0][2].split(',') and 'ignore-size' in exact[0][2].split(',')
 subprocess.run(base+['detach-client','-t',row['tty']],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=3)
 assert select.select([fd],[],[],5)[0], 'observer exit not verified'
 print(json.dumps({'run_id':s['run_id'],'pid':pid,'birth':row['birth'],'tty':row['tty'],'actual_exit_verified':True,'readonly_observer_only':True,'observed_unix_time':time.time()}))
finally:os.close(fd)
'@
$raw=& wsl -d Ubuntu -u piotr --exec $r.python_launcher -I -B -c $code $r.manifest $lp
if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'Readonly observer cleanup failed'}
$exit=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$ep=Join-Path $c.artifact_root ('windows-observer-'+$taskSize+'-exit.json')
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ep){throw 'Existing observer exit proof'}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($ep,($exit|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$exit|ConvertTo-Json
